title: Gendang Di Pagar Sekolah
subject: the security guard of a kampung primary school who brings his gendang to the gate on the first day of term, with the bus driver on serunai and the office clerk on gong, until the crying Year One children march in and the mothers are the ones crying
caption: Malay gendang silat song, the drum-and-shawm ensemble that accompanies silat displays, set as a rousing folk song. A serunai shawm playing a nasal, ornamented modal melody with circular breathing; a gendang ibu and gendang anak pair in fast interlocking strokes, booming open tones against sharp slaps; a hanging tetawak gong marking every cycle; small kesi hand cymbals ticking the time. Outdoor close-mic folk recording with a little school-yard echo, no modern drum kit. Male lead with a warm mid-baritone and a rough, cheerful village-elder delivery, a small group of men answering the chorus. 128 BPM, G minor. Rousing, warm and comic. No pop drums, no EDM, no dangdut, no rock guitars, no orchestral strings.
lyrics:
[Intro - serunai solo over gendang ibu and gendang anak, gong on every cycle]

[Verse 1]
Pukul tujuh pagi, pintu pagar aku buka
Budak Tahun Satu, beg lebih besar dari badan
Ada yang pegang kain mak, tak nak lepas
Ada yang menangis sampai basah lengan baju

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku letak topi guard atas kerusi
Ambil gendang ibu yang aku bawa dari rumah

[Chorus]
Tak, tak, dum! Gendang di pagar
Serunai Pak Leh mula meninggi
Lap air mata, angkat kaki
Masuk kelas macam pendekar!

[Verse 2]
Pak Leh drebar bas, serunai dalam beg
Kak Yah kerani gantung gong tepi pejabat
Si Danish berhenti nangis, mula hentak kaki
Si Aisyah tolak tangan mak, "Mak balik la, cepat!"

[Chorus]
Tak, tak, dum! Gendang di pagar
Serunai Pak Leh makin meninggi
Sekarang mak-mak pula yang menangis
Anak dah berbaris macam pendekar!

[Bridge - gendang solo, gong on the cycle]
Loceng berbunyi, gendang aku perlahankan
Topi aku pakai balik, pagar aku jaga macam biasa

[Chorus]
Tak, tak, dum! Gendang di pagar
Tahun depan giliran siapa?
Kalau ada yang menangis lagi
Pak Mat ada, gendang pun ada!

[Outro - serunai and gendang speed up, one last gong]
